item.tib: kun bzang thugs kyi yang thig rgyud las lam 'khyer rnam gsum
item.coloph: snyigs ma'i kho bo pad ma g.yung drung gsal/ gsang mtshan badz+nyA zhes pa'i rnal 'byor bdag snyan du brgyud cing bka' rgya gdams pa bcas/ bdag gi gsang ba'i bka' rgya thub par byas/ de nas phyi rabs 'gro ba'i don ched du/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug tu/ me lug zla tshes bzang po la/ phyi rabs don du man ngag yi ger btab/ 'gro ba bla med drangs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
